src: Your {{W|Strength}} score determines how effectively you penetrate your opponents' armor with melee attacks, how much damage your melee attacks do, your ability to resist forced movement, and your carry capacity.
Your {{W|Agility}} score determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged weapons and your ability to dodge attacks.
Your {{W|Toughness}} score determines your number of hit points, your natural healing rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.
Your {{W|Intelligence}} score determines your number of skill points and your ability to examine artifacts.
Your {{W|Willpower}} score modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities, determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your natural healing rate.
Your {{W|Ego}} score determines the potency of your mental mutations, your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
